_comment: The hybrid gate. Score 0-100, additive; >= autoMin loads without asking,
reviewMin..autoMin-1 goes to out/review-queue.jsonl for a human, below
reviewMin is dropped but logged to out/dropped.jsonl.
Tuning is a data commit, not a code change, and `version` is recorded in the
run manifest so a given batch can always be traced to the numbers that
Hard overrides apply AFTER the numeric band and cannot be scored around:
- a 'foreign-name' warning caps at review (never auto)
- a tier2-only market caps at review
- no scan count AND no brand forces drop -- both conditions, because
unique_scans_n is absent on ~65% of the database and absence must mean
nameRo 20 vs nameEn 12: an English name is legitimate for an international
brand on a Romanian shelf, so it may auto-load, but it has to earn the rest
of its score rather than coast in.
